strings: Recently, m_c has been feeling so worn down. It's all that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can do to explain to r_c0 the awful overwhelming feeling that prickles just beneath {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} fur.
Despite the cheerful air around the rest of the Clan, m_c refuses to leave {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nest, curled up and feeling rather miserable.
m_c has been feeling awfully tired lately, like a heavy fog is weighing down {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} paws.
